text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Cheval. ……Oh my, your chest 
ribbon is crooked.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I-It's fine. I can fix it myself……

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? ……Say, how has school been 
lately? You aren't overworking yourself in 
training, are you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You tend to bottle everything up inside, 
after all…… If anything comes up, come 
tell me, alright? Promise me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
……Nee-san was acting strange this morning. 
She was hovering over me even more than 
usual……

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Come to think of it, her face was 
slightly flushed. Wait…… could it be……)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ……I knew it. You were pushing yourself.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Eh, Cheval? Why are you here……

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
……Because you seemed different from 
usual……

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: You weren't feeling well, were you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
……No, it's not anything worth making a 
fuss over, truly. I'm simply resting as a 
precaution……

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
……I bought some things that looked useful. 
Come to think of it, where is Tarumae-san?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
She's away on an away race right now. 
Though I believe she'll be back the day 
after tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...What about food? Did you eat?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No, not yet. I was just thinking of making 
something to eat now.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, huh? Cheval? ...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(When you catch a cold, you eat... rice 
porridge, right? If it's just porridge, 
even I can...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: H-Huh...? The rice... is still hard...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, I messed up the water 
measurements...! Ugh, one more time...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ......The flavor... might be too strong...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...... N-Next time for sure...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ......H-How is it?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's very delicious. Not bad at all, 
Cheval!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...You really don't have to be polite, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm not being polite in the slightest. 
It's easy on the stomach, and the 
seasoning is just right.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...You remade it over and over for me, 
didn't you? Your heartfelt care comes 
through completely.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: That is why it tastes so wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
If it didn't taste bad... then I guess 
it's okay.

One day in front of the classroom, Cheval 
Grand and Verxina were talking.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for yesterday, Cheval. Thanks to 
you, I've recovered my strength. It's all 
thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. If I get to be nursed by Cheval, 
maybe catching a cold once in a while 
isn't so bad after all.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't even say that as a joke... Things 
like that...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I was... really worried, you know...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you're right... I'm sorry for making 
you worry.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Being surrounded by such wonderful 
younger sisters, I truly am blessed.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for yesterday, Cheval. Thanks to 
you, my cold didn't drag on.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if Cheval's porridge did the 
trick? It really was delicious, after all.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Say, will you make it for me 
again?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ............ If... I feel like it...
